title: Lupin Leads — Meta Lead Campaign
summary: Facebook and Instagram lead ads for contractors, with a version for each trade.
overview: Lupin Leads offers contractors qualified leads for $100 a week. We made the ad creative and set up and manage the Facebook and Instagram campaign that brings those contractors in.

cover.alt: Lupin Leads ad: a contractor in a cap looks up beside a house frame, with the headline Get more qualified leads for only $100 a week

challenge.heading: The brief
body: Reach contractors in a way that feels relevant to their trade, and make the offer clear in a quick scroll: one price, one promise.

idea.heading: The approach
body: Every ad keeps the same headline and price, and the image changes to match the trade — a general contractor, a plumber, a framer. The purple-and-black look and the arrow keep them recognisable as one brand.

execution.heading: How the campaign runs
body: Audiences set by trade and area, with the offer in every ad.
Square and vertical versions of each ad, made in-house so new ones can be tested quickly.
Meta instant forms with a few qualifying questions.
Tracking from ad to lead, regular budget and creative adjustments, and a monthly report on cost per lead.
